Basic Fishing Rod.Description: A plain permit rod for Mistfall's everyday catch. Its line can be refined, but it will not truly reach deep water.

Golden Fish.Description: A fish bright as sun on water, used as payment for a finer rod, more valuable on the counter than in a supper crate.

Golden Tentacle.Description: Gleaming tentacle bait that draws the deepest bites. Each resolved bite spends bait from the stack.

OuwFish.Description: Everyday Mistfall catch, plain enough for crates but welcome wherever supper has to stretch.

OuwFwesh.Description: Dockhands keep the old misspelling on the tag. The fish itself is clean, pale, and good for crates.

Fish Head.Description: Sour bait that draws better bites and is spent when the line resolves. Fit it to a rod that can hold brighter fish.

Zebra Fish.Description: Striped harbor fish with firm flesh, set aside for market crates and tailors who prize a clean stripe.

Coral.Description: Salt hardened coral snapped from harbor rock, traded by fish buyers and worked into sea scarred gear.

Golden Tentacle x75.Description: A bulk order of Golden Tentacle bait, enough to keep a line in deep water through a very long watch.

Crustadon.Description: Heavy shelled deepwater brute. Old anglers keep it whole, remembering what dragged a man below.

Drowned Lure.Description: Knotted lure from Isao's lost line. It is not spent by the bite, and the river favors empty reels around it.

Krathulon.Description: Long bodied deep catch with a jaw like a dock cleat. Iceveil stores prize it because it keeps through cold travel.

Legendary Fishing Rod.Description: Isao's handmade rod, raised from the river. It reaches sunken gear when other lines still find only fish.

Golden Tentacle x10.Description: A small order of Golden Tentacle bait, delivered as a bundle rather than as a single lure.

Worm.Description: Fresh dock bait for the shallow table. Resolved bites take from the stack, whether the hook comes back full or bare.

Clown Fish.Description: Brightly banded harbor catch, pretty enough for market talk and useful when pantries need more than small fry.

Sea Horse.Description: Small curled catch from eelgrass beds, dried whole for market stalls and anglers' crates.

Rare Fishing Rod.Description: A better built rod earned with Golden Fish. It reaches the brighter catches that the permit rod mostly misses.
